_meta.description: Panel (盤面) schema. All values are deviations from the average healthy person (zero). See docs/wuxing-algorithm.md §9 and SOP §8.

derived.bagang.cold_heat: clamp(−1…1) = (liuxie.火 + liuxie.暑 − liuxie.寒 − 0.5·Σ yang deficit + 0.5·Σ yin deficit) / 3
derived.bagang.deficiency_excess: clamp(−1…1) = (Σ positive channel excess + products + stasis + Σ positive 營衛 − Σ negative channel deficit − Σ negative 營衛) / 6
derived.bagang.yin_yang: derived summary (axes beyond scoring-params panel.bagang.yin_yang_axis_threshold): hot and not deficient → yang; cold and not excess, or hot with deficiency (陰虛內熱) → yin; only excess → yang; only deficiency → yin; cold with excess (寒實) → mixed; nothing beyond the threshold → balanced
derived.degree_from_pct: degree = 3 · Pct / 100 for each pattern element
derived.yingwei.coupling: each pattern's 營衛 also gains c · Σ w·min(source, 0) from its own organ deficits: 衛 ← 0.5·肺.qi + 0.15·脾.qi + 0.15·脾.yang + 0.2·腎.yang; 營 ← 0.6·脾.qi + 0.4·心.blood; c = 0.3 (data/diagnosis/yingwei.json)

offsets.primary: observed − 0 (deviation from the average healthy person; drives diagnosis)

scale.營: −3 營弱（不能內守）… +3 營強（營鬱）
scale.衛: −3 衛弱（衛外不固）… +3 衛實
scale.開闔: −3 開（腠理疏，汗出）… +3 闔（腠理閉，無汗）
